WILSON BLADE V4 2026 - The new Blade arrives renewed, with a slight design change and with improved technologies to achieve a more balanced and durable racket. Without a doubt, one of the Wilson rackets with the best quality-price ratio. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The WILSON BLADE V4 2026 arrives completely renewed to continue being one of the brand's most balanced padel rackets. Its teardrop format helps us achieve that balance so desired by players.

It is a racket that transmits a lot of confidence both from the back of the court and in the net game.

PLAYER TYPE

Designed for players looking for an excellent compromise between control, power and comfort, it offers a very versatile behavior that adapts to any match situation.

The materials in the WILSON BLADE V4 2026 are quality. We find a combination of carbon fiber and fiberglass. With this duo, a balanced, flexible feel and good durability are achieved.

Its rubber is firm Foam, a hard and stable rubber that increases the power in our blows, but also leaving us with the characteristic softness of foam rubber.

Its technologies are: a rough surface Spin Effect Texture, which facilitates the generation of effects. Its C2 Tubular Construction structure, made entirely of carbon. In addition, the Anti-Fragile Edge protector reinforces the frame against bumps and scratches, while the Duo Grid Hole system optimizes the performance of the hitting surface.

products.title: Drop Shot Axion Attack 2024 Jon Sanz - Palas De Padel
products.description:
DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ - Jon Sanz's new padel racket for 2024 in the Premier Pádel professional padel league. A model that combines great precision, along with fantastic power thanks to its teardrop mold and technologies.

 INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

Drop Shot is one of the leading brands in the padel racket sector. Models like the classic Conqueror have been with us for almost a decade. Today we bring you the DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ, the new racket that the Premier Padel player Jon Sanz will use, and that seeks maximum power without losing the control that characterizes it.

PLAYER TYPE

The DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ has been created for advanced or professional level players looking for a versatile padel racket made of great materials.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The new DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ contains elements that make it stand out as a perfect padel racket for powerful players. It is a racket created in a teardrop format, with a good sweet spot and handling, which facilitates maximum power in the game without loss of control.

In its manufacturing, Drop Shot has used common elements in its padel rackets such as plain carbon and Hotmelt technology to make its frame more resistant and durable, a double tubular of carbon fabrics with maximum durability, which gives it greater rigidity and allows it to not lose power. Textrem Cubicarbon 18K twill technology appears on the interlocking carbon faces, giving the faces flexibility and greater durability for a more comfortable and pleasant touch.

Along with these materials, top-of-the-range technologies appear such as the 3D FACE, in a rhomboidal shape that provides greater spin to the ball when hitting, ideal for aggressive players and sliced ​​shots. The Anti Twist System technology also appears in this model, preventing vibrations, making this DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ one of the ideal padel rackets for players who want a powerful racket but with good balance.  In the core we find EVA PRO rubber with greater hardness and elasticity, which provides better control and touch of the ball.

It incorporates a protector on the frame of the racket to increase its durability, what the Madrid firm calls Ergo Pro Protector.

BLADE DESIGN

The design of the DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ has opted for a striking color combination, which changes yellow, silver, black and green.

PLAY STYLE

The new DROP SHOT EXPLORER PRO 3.0 is one of the ideal Drop Shot rackets for advanced or professional players who want an attacking racket, but with good control.

products.description:
HEAD BOLT BK PR 2025 - Elegant control racket with low weight and two-tone logo. INTRODUCTION TO THE PADDLE

Sober shovel in design, with an anagram in purple or blue depending on the angle of light. Lots of control and medium soft touch, approximate weight 350 grams.

Its reinforced frame has an integrated protector to show optimal strength against any knocks it may suffer. Inside we have a Power Foam that helps reduce vibrations from impacts and offering a very controlled reaction when touching the ball. 

PLAY STYLE

Given its balance and internal composition, we can affirm that this racket facilitates handling and control of the ball for those novice players who need a non-injurious racket that helps pass the ball easily, even if they do not have good hitting technique.

products.title: Head Graphene 360 Attitude 2025 - Head
products.description:
HEAD GRAPHENE 360 ATTITUDE 2025 - The new product from Head arrives this 2025, a teardrop format racket, sensational quality and more technologies than ever. Comfort Foam rubber to give us great ball output and vibration absorption. Get the best power and a pleasant touch without losing control in this Top seller from Head Pádel. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

Head Padel surprises us again with a new model that will appeal to all types of players due to its design and performance. This is the new HEAD GRAPHENE 360 ATTITUDE 2025, a high-quality versatile racket that combines a fantastic sweet spot and a great ball output.

PLAYER TYPE

The HEAD GRAPHENE 360 ATTITUDE 2025 has been created for advanced level players who are looking for an attacking racket with good sensations on the court in terms of comfort, but without neglecting control, being a versatile racket that will delight players who like to hit the ball and will surely be very amazed at the great power of this model.

FEATURES AND TECHNOLOGIES OF THE SHOVEL

We delve into the features and construction materials section of this model. A padel racket with which good sensations are guaranteed, thanks in part to its mold.

Head Pádel has used in this HEAD GRAPHENE 360 ATTITUDE 2025 a teardrop format, common in the brand's rackets, which achieves a greater sweet spot than in models from previous years thanks to the Extended impact zone and a fantastic balance in power and control. Its intermediate balance achieves great handling without losing punch.

In its construction we find quality technologies such as carbon that appears in the frame reinforcing the blade. The integrated IPS protector protects the edges from possible knocks or scratches during the game. The optimized Sweet Spot improves the sweet spot of the racket this year more than ever, with a drill of larger holes placed strategically, expanding the impact zone.

Inside we find the Comfort Foam rubber, a Head regular, which gives it a great ball output and a very pleasant touch, along with pleasant vibration absorption.

Another technology this year is the Tailored Tube, which makes the rubber reach the end of the entire blade, greatly expanding the impact area.

For the plane, it uses a material used in anti-flight vests such as Graphene 360, which gives it rigidity and high durability.

And finally Smart Bridge, which is a technology that is used in the bridge area to make it individually included in the mold, which improves the characteristics of the racket and its playability on the court.

BLADE DESIGN

The design of the HEAD GRAPHENE 360 ATTITUDE 2025 is fantastic, a common modern style in head padel for this 2025, which leaves us with one of the most beautiful padel rackets on the market, combining red and orange with black and white details.

PLAY STYLE

The new HEAD GRAPHENE 360 ATTITUDE 2025 is a sensational racket that complements attacking playing styles, with a high ball output and good touch but without losing control, thanks to the Comfort Foam.
